$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F09 hero (H). Temple edges first from darkestshades/brand/lightbox/onyx-emblem/process/cfgs.py. The GCD is measured with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py, the old print as a ruler: on F09 it lies 24.1 to 39.9 mm from the hinge, read square on in the left profile (IMG_3402, where the temple's height is the same along its length); this shot's own 3D model agrees within 2 to 5% (it depends on how the hinge line's slant is taken). The hinge line slants across the face (3.2 mm along the temple from its top to its bottom on the side drawing; 11 degrees in the left profile). The first placement drew the GCD about 40% too long for the angle at which the temple is seen.

lenses.name: far lens (defocused, cut by the frame edge)

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old logo, near temple
